The admin re-opened workspace settings and confirmed the webhook URL field still shows the value they originally pasted in from Zapier: https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/1234567/AbCdEfG/. On Zapier's side, that same catch hook still shows as existing and enabled in their dashboard. No one has changed or regenerated the hook since it was set up.
